title: SCI headless compiler component rights and provenance
scope: Exact 179 compile source/header inputs in the validated minimal headless build; supporting licenses/notices are additional packaging files

redistribution_notice_requirements: Preserve upstream copyright/grant/warranty notices, GPL text, copied-code attributions and modification notices
Distribute GPL-covered derivative compiler source under GPL-2.0-or-later
If distributing a compiler executable, provide corresponding source and build instructions under an applicable GPL section 3 method
caveats: The port directory has its own explicit GPL grant; the surrounding MIT project does not override it
Historical port modifications predate publication; the 2026-10-06 notice dates the documentation addition only
Port-authored CCrystalTextBuffer is a replacement interface implementation, not the excluded CrystalEdit implementation

redistribution_notice_requirements: Preserve individual notices and program-level GPL-2.0-or-later grant
Preserve notices of modifications and GPL source distribution rights
caveats: The explicit program-level License.txt grounds original code without repeated file headers; this is not a blanket license declaration for unrelated vendor components

redistribution_notice_requirements: Preserve the exact public-domain declaration, notice-retention instruction and warranty disclaimer

publication_notice_verification.result: All distributed port source/header files preserve exact pre-notice bytes following comment-only additions

excluded_scope: Unretained vendor GUI implementations and resources
